phoneSetup.title: Phone setup
phoneSetup.stoppedOnce: {phone} stopped Fame Driver for {minutes} min ({when}). No trip is recorded while it is stopped.
phoneSetup.stoppedMany: {phone} stopped Fame Driver {count} times since {when}, {minutes} min in all. No trip is recorded while it is stopped.

oppo: Settings → Apps → Fame Driver → Battery usage: turn on "Allow background activity" and "Allow auto launch".
Settings → Battery → More settings → Optimise battery use: Fame Driver → "Don't optimise".
Recent apps: pull Fame Driver down (or tap the lock) so it stays locked.
realme: Settings → Apps → Fame Driver → Battery usage: turn on "Allow background activity" and "Allow auto launch".
Settings → Battery → App battery management: Fame Driver → allow running in the background.
Recent apps: pull Fame Driver down (or tap the lock) so it stays locked.
xiaomi: Settings → Apps → Fame Driver: turn on "Autostart".
Recent apps: hold Fame Driver and tap the lock.
vivo: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management: Fame Driver → "Allow".
i Manager → App manager → Autostart: turn on Fame Driver.
Recent apps: pull Fame Driver down so it stays locked.
samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: Fame Driver must not be in "Sleeping apps" or "Deep sleeping apps"; add it to "Never sleeping apps".
Recent apps: tap the Fame Driver icon → "Keep open".
other: Settings → Apps → Fame Driver → Battery: allow background activity, no restrictions.
If the phone has "Autostart" or "Auto launch", turn it on for Fame Driver.
Recent apps: lock Fame Driver so it stays open.
huawei: Settings → Battery → App launch → Fame Driver: turn off "Manage automatically", then turn on all three switches.
Recent apps: pull Fame Driver down (or tap the lock) so it stays locked.
